title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command
code:
title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Command
id: a1b2c3d4-0001
status: stable
description: Detects PowerShell execution using the -EncodedCommand parameter, commonly used to obfuscate malicious script content.
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '-enc'
            - '-EncodedCommand'
    condition: selection
level: medium
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
description: Detects PowerShell execution using the -EncodedCommand parameter, commonly used to obfuscate malicious script content.

title: Mimikatz Process Execution
code:
title: Mimikatz Process Execution
id: a1b2c3d4-0002
status: stable
description: Detects execution of mimikatz.exe or common renamed variants by process image name.
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\\mimikatz.exe'
            - '\\mimidrv.sys'
        OriginalFileName: 'mimikatz.exe'
    condition: selection
level: critical
tags:
    - attack.credential_access
    - attack.t1003
description: Detects execution of mimikatz.exe or common renamed variants by process image name.

title: Multiple Failed SSH Logins (Brute Force)
code:
title: Multiple Failed SSH Logins (Brute Force)
id: a1b2c3d4-0003
status: stable
description: Detects a high volume of failed SSH authentication attempts from a single source within a short window.
logsource:
    category: authentication
    product: linux
    service: sshd
detection:
    selection:
        message|contains: 'Failed password'
    timeframe: 5m
    condition: selection | count() by src_ip > 10
level: medium
tags:
    - attack.credential_access
    - attack.t1110
description: Detects a high volume of failed SSH authentication attempts from a single source within a short window.

title: New Local Administrator Account Added
code:
title: New Local Administrator Account Added
id: a1b2c3d4-0004
status: stable
description: Detects a user being added to the local Administrators group, EventID 4732 on the domain member or DC.
logsource:
    category: security
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:
    selection:
        EventID: 4732
        TargetUserName|contains: 'Administrators'
    condition: selection
level: medium
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1098
description: Detects a user being added to the local Administrators group, EventID 4732 on the domain member or DC.

title: Scheduled Task Creation via schtasks.exe
code:
title: Scheduled Task Creation via schtasks.exe
id: a1b2c3d4-0005
status: stable
description: Detects creation of a new scheduled task from the command line, a common persistence technique.
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\\schtasks.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: '/create'
    condition: selection
level: low
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1053.005
description: Detects creation of a new scheduled task from the command line, a common persistence technique.

title: Suspicious Outbound Connection to Known Malicious Port
code:
title: Suspicious Outbound Connection to Known Malicious Port
id: a1b2c3d4-0006
status: stable
description: Detects outbound network connections to ports commonly associated with reverse shells (e.g. 4444, 1337, 31337).
logsource:
    category: network_connection
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        DestinationPort:
            - 4444
            - 1337
            - 31337
        Initiated: 'true'
    condition: selection
level: medium
tags:
    - attack.command_and_control
    - attack.t1571
description: Detects outbound network connections to ports commonly associated with reverse shells (e.g. 4444, 1337, 31337).

title: LSASS Process Access (Credential Dumping)
code:
title: LSASS Process Access (Credential Dumping)
id: a1b2c3d4-0007
status: stable
description: Detects a process opening a handle to lsass.exe with access rights consistent with credential dumping.
logsource:
    category: process_access
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        TargetImage|endswith: '\\lsass.exe'
        GrantedAccess: '0x1010'
    condition: selection
level: high
tags:
    - attack.credential_access
    - attack.t1003.001
description: Detects a process opening a handle to lsass.exe with access rights consistent with credential dumping.

title: Disabling Windows Defender via PowerShell
code:
title: Disabling Windows Defender via PowerShell
id: a1b2c3d4-0008
status: stable
description: Detects PowerShell commands attempting to disable real-time protection, a common pre-payload defense-evasion step.
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring'
    condition: selection
level: high
tags:
    - attack.defense_evasion
    - attack.t1562.001
description: Detects PowerShell commands attempting to disable real-time protection, a common pre-payload defense-evasion step.

title: Suspicious Use of certutil to Download File
code:
title: Suspicious Use of certutil to Download File

    product: windows

        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'urlcache'
            - '-verifyctl'
    condition: selection
level: high
tags:
    - attack.command_and_control
    - attack.t1105
description: Detects certutil.exe being used with -urlcache or -verifyctl to download a remote file, a common living-off-the-land technique.

title: Web Shell Indicator — Suspicious Child Process of Web Server
code:
title: Web Shell Indicator — Suspicious Child Process of Web Server
id: a1b2c3d4-0011
status: stable
description: Detects a shell (cmd.exe/powershell.exe/bash) spawned as a child process of a web server process, a strong web-shell indicator.
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\\w3wp.exe'
            - '\\httpd.exe'
            - '\\nginx.exe'
        Image|endswith:
            - '\\cmd.exe'
            - '\\powershell.exe'
    condition: selection
level: high
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1505.003
description: Detects a shell (cmd.exe/powershell.exe/bash) spawned as a child process of a web server process, a strong web-shell indicator.

title: Rare Parent-Child Process — Office Spawning Shell
code:
title: Rare Parent-Child Process — Office Spawning Shell
id: a1b2c3d4-0013
status: stable
description: Detects an Office application (Word/Excel/Outlook) spawning a command shell, a classic sign of a malicious macro.
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith:
            - '\\winword.exe'
            - '\\excel.exe'
            - '\\outlook.exe'
        Image|endswith:
            - '\\cmd.exe'
            - '\\powershell.exe'
    condition: selection
level: high
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1204.002
description: Detects an Office application (Word/Excel/Outlook) spawning a command shell, a classic sign of a malicious macro.

title: Suspicious Base64-Encoded Command Line
code:
title: Suspicious Base64-Encoded Command Line
id: a1b2c3d4-0014
status: stable
description: Detects command lines containing a long base64-looking string, often indicating an encoded/obfuscated payload.
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|re: '[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{100,}'
    condition: selection
level: medium
tags:
    - attack.defense_evasion
    - attack.t1027
description: Detects command lines containing a long base64-looking string, often indicating an encoded/obfuscated payload.

title: RDP Brute Force Followed by Successful Logon
code:
title: RDP Brute Force Followed by Successful Logon
id: a1b2c3d4-0015
status: stable
description: Detects a burst of failed RDP logons (4625) from one source followed by a success (4624) — a brute-force-then-compromise pattern.
logsource:
    category: security
    product: windows
    service: security
detection:
    selection_fail:
        EventID: 4625
        LogonType: 10
    selection_success:
        EventID: 4624
        LogonType: 10
    timeframe: 10m
    condition: selection_fail | count() by IpAddress > 10 and selection_success
level: high
tags:
    - attack.credential_access
    - attack.t1110
description: Detects a burst of failed RDP logons (4625) from one source followed by a success (4624) — a brute-force-then-compromise pattern.
